# Hello Art Therapy — Anna Worthington

> Hello Art Therapy is Anna Worthington's art therapy practice in Fitzroy, Victoria, Australia, offering online and in-person individual sessions, parent/child sessions and group work, including corporate groups.

This is a concise guide to the most useful public pages on Anna's official website. For therapy enquiries, start with the contact page. No art-making experience is required to participate in art therapy. For the full list of public website pages, use https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/sitemap-index.xml.

Online and in-person sessions have the same price for each session type. Published prices are AUD $140 for a one-hour individual session and AUD $150 for a caregiver/child session. Parent/child sessions run for 1.5 hours. Contact Anna for group and corporate enquiries, current availability and booking details.

## Core Pages

- [Contact Anna](https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/contact): Email Anna or submit the website form to enquire about art therapy sessions and group work.
- [Home](https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/): Introduction to Hello Art Therapy, what art therapy can help with and what Anna offers.
- [What is Art Therapy?](https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/new-page): Anna's explanation of art therapy and her relational, phenomenological approach to creative expression.
- [How it works](https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/how-it-works): The creative process, session options, online and in-person sessions, and pricing.
- [About Anna](https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/about-1): Anna Worthington's journey, professional experience and education in expressive arts therapies.
- [Privacy and analytics](https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/analytics-privacy): Information about contact enquiries, optional website analytics and visitor choices.

## Art Therapy Sessions

- [Individual sessions](https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/how-it-works#individual-sessions): Personalised one-to-one art therapy sessions.
- [Parent/child sessions](https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/how-it-works#parent-child-sessions): Relational art-making sessions for children or young people with a parent or caregiver.
- [Group work](https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/how-it-works#group-work): Creative group sessions. Group work is also available for corporate groups; contact Anna to enquire.
- [Session pricing](https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/how-it-works#session-pricing): Published session prices. Online and in-person prices are the same for each session type.

## Book

- [Art for the Everyday](https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/art-for-the-everyday): Anna Worthington's book of 24 creative exercises for curiosity and self-reflection. Includes book details and an Amazon purchase link.
- [Art for the Everyday on Amazon Australia](https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0HMHYSVPV): The book's Amazon listing. This is an educational creative workbook, not a replacement for individual therapy, diagnosis or treatment.

## Podcast, Videos and Writing

- [Hello Art Therapy on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/2HYK9V80ALHtTqfCFbb2lt): Anna's podcast. Matching episode links are also available within companion blog articles.
- [Hello Art Therapy on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCO7ijN4udMnVMYP2G2Cgp-A): Anna's YouTube channel. Matching video links are available within companion blog articles.
- [Blog — Words, pictures and things](https://www.annaworthingtonarttherapy.com/blog): Anna's articles exploring art, creativity, relationships and lived experience.
